title.narrative: Primary Health Care Quality Improvement Program

description.narrative: The Program Development Objective is to contribute to improving the quality of primary health care services in the Kyrgyz Republic.

The original Program for Results (PforR) focuses on three results areas: (a) Result area 1: Integrating sustainable quality improvement mechanisms into service delivery; (b) Result area 2: Strengthening strategic purchasing for the quality of care; and (c) Result area 3: Strengthening health sector stewardship and governance for quality improvement. The proposed additional financing (AF) will be processed as a new IPF component to the PforR and is expected to improve implementation performance by providing required technical assistance (TA) and additional goods essential to achieve the Program's development objectives. The AF will be reflected under Component 2 of the Program, which will have two sub-components. The first subcomponent 2.1 will finance goods and services, and the second subcomponent 2.2 will finance TA to support the achievement of program results.

condition.narrative: The Recipient shall maintain, throughout the implementation of the Program, an independent verification agent with qualificationsand experience and under term of reference acceptable to the Bank to verify the data and other evidence supporting the achievementof one or more DLIs
The Recipient, through MoF, MoH and MHIF, shall carry out the Program in accordance with the Program Operation Manual.
The Recipient, through MoH, shall furnish to the Association each Program Report not later than one month after the end of eachcalendar semester, covering the calendar semester.
